notes:
Background: mid-market SaaS product team (customer engagement / ticket automation). Evaluated Redwood Hosted API for a 4-week trial; now sizing Dedicated for consistent latency and lower unit cost.

Hosted trial summary (observed via Redwood Console):
- Duration: 2024-12-15 -> 2025-01-10 (4 weeks).
- Workload mix: chat-style support conversations (60% of calls), embeddings for search (25%), reranking (10%), summarization snippets (5%).
- Traffic profile: average QPS = 42, median concurrency = 12, peak QPS = 160 (observed during Monday morning surge), peak concurrent requests = 48.
- Token mix: avg input 230 tokens, avg output 310 tokens => avg total ~540 tokens/call. Heavy tails: ~8% of calls >2k tokens (long-form summaries and troubleshooting transcripts).
- KV/prefix cache hit-rate: observed 18% on repetitive prompts (support templates).
- Latency: Hosted p50 = 85ms, p95 = 320ms (outliers tied to cold KV misses and long-token responses).
- Error rate: <0.3% 5xx; transient throttles during peak burst windows.

Customer goals / constraints:
- P95 inference latency target: <= 250ms for support chat.
- Sustained throughput target: 120-150 QPS; burst to 300 QPS for 10-20 minute peaks.
- Cost sensitivity: wants unit cost reduction vs Hosted once traffic stable (target 30-50% lower per-token cost).
- Security: strict SSO (SAML), SOC2/ISO readiness, audit logs retained 13 months, EU data residency for EU customers.
- Operational: ability to pin model versions, canary rollouts, and automatic fallback to smaller quantized models under load.

Technical preferences discovered in calls: "Prefer a mix of open LLMs (Llama-family variants) for cost + an opt-in higher-quality model for escalations" (quote from Head of ML). They want model routing based on intent: small model for simple answers, larger for multi-turn escalations.

POC / Eval activities to date:
- 2025-01-08: Demo (hosted API + console deep dive) — AE/Jordan, SE/Priya, Head of ML + infra lead attended (ff-20250122-aurum-intro).
- 2025-01-15: Instrumentation run — telemetry hooks added to prod-sim (captured token mix & latencies).
- 2025-01-22: Mid-POC check — analyzed batching vs latency trade-offs. Noted batch sizes of 8 improve throughput but raise p95 by ~40ms.
- 2025-02-02: PO C review w/ cost & capacity discussion (ff-20250202-poc-review).
- Security kickoff: exchanged security FAQ + initial SCIM/SAML requirements (SEC-8810).

Dedicated sizing ask (current proposal draft):
- Target sustained QPS: 150 (primary pool), burst pool for +150 QPS for 15m windows.
- Concurrency planning: average concurrency target 20, buffer for peak concurrency 60.
- GPU worker estimate: 4 inference worker nodes (each ~8 A100-equivalent vGPU capacity) — projected sustained throughput ~180 QPS with token mix above; burst pool scales to reach 300 QPS.
- Token forecast (30-day window): baseline 42 QPS -> monthly tokens ~550M tokens. For dedicated target 150 QPS sustained -> forecast ~1.9B tokens/month. Use-case adjusted forecast (expected ramp over 3 months): month1 700M, month2 1.3B, month3 1.9B.
- Cost estimate ask: provide two bands: conservative (4-worker pool + 1 burst node) and aggressive (6-worker pool + 2 burst nodes).

Open questions from POC that impact sizing/pricing:
- Cache effectiveness: can we push cache hit-rate from 18% -> 35% with prompt reworks? If so, effective QPS/k-cost lowers.
- How much latency overhead does continuous batching introduce at their typical 300-600 token responses?
- Regional residency: need EU-only Dedicated pool for a subset of customers (adds duplication factor to sizing).

Next steps (ownership):
- AE (Jordan) to send Dedicated sizing proposal + dual pricing bands by 2025-02-07 (action).
- SE (Priya) to run targeted workload simulation with higher cache priming to validate optimistic cache hit-rate (action).
- Legal to start MSA + security addendum (customer to provide procurement timeline).
- Customer: budget confirmation expected end of Feb, SAML integration window TBD.

Notes / CRM shorthand:
- Customer eager to move from Hosted -> Dedicated if price delta and latency stable.
- Watch EU residency ask — may push to multi-region Dedicated or Private later.
- "If we can get p95 <250 and 40% cost reduction -> greenlight" — Head of Product (paraphrase).
